title: Senter Music Festival 2026 Overview
content:
Senter Music Festival 2026 is South Asia's premier EDM and electronic dance music festival presented by LFG Global Entertainment Group Pte. Ltd. and Senter Records. It features global superstar DJ Snake performing live in Sri Lanka for a special 2-day Halloween Edition.
- Dates: Friday, October 30 and Saturday, October 31, 2026 (2 Full Days and Nights).
- Venue: Port City Colombo, Western Province, Sri Lanka (Postal Code: 00100).
- Expected Attendance: Over 30,000+ festival goers from Sri Lanka and across South Asia.
- Festival Timings: Gates open at 4:00 PM on both days. Music and festival performances run from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM daily.
- Ticket Validity: Each ticket is valid for both days of Senter Fest (one admission entry per day, no re-entry permitted).
- Official Websites: https://www.sentermusicfestival.com and https://www.senterfest.com
- Official Emails: tickets@lfg-entertainment.com and hello@lfg-entertainment.com

metadata.ticket_validity: Valid for both days (one entry per day)

title: DJ Snake - Headliner Profile & Hit Records
content:
DJ Snake is the main headliner for Senter Music Festival 2026. He is recognized as the #1 most popular international DJ and multi-platinum French producer performing live in South Asia, with over 60 Million global followers and multiple songs in the Billion Streams Club:
- 'Let Me Love You' (feat. Justin Bieber) - 3.17 Billion streams
- 'Lean On' (with Major Lazer feat. MO) - 2.76 Billion streams
- 'Taki Taki' (feat. Selena Gomez, Ozuna, Cardi B) - 1.86 Billion streams
- 'Middle' (feat. Bipolar Sunshine) - 1.33 Billion streams
- 'Turn Down for What' (with Lil Jon) - 1.2 Billion streams
- 'Loco Contigo' (feat. J Balvin & Tyga) - 995 Million streams
- 'Get Low' (with Dillon Francis) - 776 Million streams
- 'You Know You Like It' (with AlunaGeorge) - 687 Million streams
- 'A Different Way' (feat. Lauv) - 320 Million streams
DJ Snake will perform an exclusive 2-Night South Asia festival headlining set in Colombo.

title: Supporting Lineup & Resident Artists
content:
The festival lineup includes international headliner DJ Snake alongside prominent regional and Sri Lankan electronic artists:
- DJ Mass (Sri Lankan EDM pioneer & producer of hit record 'Pem Kekula')
- Flecan
- 5 Additional Local & Regional Support Acts (Act 01, Act 02, Act 03, Act 04, Act 05) will be officially revealed on the website and social media closer to the event.

title: Ticket Tiers, Pricing & Purchase Rules
content:
Ticket pre-registration / presave is open on the official website (sentermusicfestival.com/tickets or sentermusicfestival.com/presave). Presave members receive 24-hour early access, priority tier selection, and early-bird discount pricing.
Official Ticket Tiers:
1. Phase 1 - General Admission (GA): LKR 15,000 (Access to Main Stage Arena, F&B village, Halloween zone & general festival areas for both days).
2. Phase 1 - VIP Pass: LKR 35,000 (Access to elevated VIP Sky Lounge, dedicated bars, express VIP queue entry, and premium viewing deck for both days).
3. VVIP Pass & Cabanas / Tables: Custom luxury concierge bookings with bottle service, dedicated servers, and ultra-premium stage viewing. For VVIP bookings and table reservations, contact the Concierge via WhatsApp or Call at +94 77 117 7118.
Key Ticketing Rules:
- Ticket Validity: Tickets are valid for BOTH days of Senter Fest.
- Purchase Limit: A maximum of ten (10) tickets per transaction / per valid identification document.
- Non-Refundable & Non-Transferable: All ticket sales are final, non-refundable, non-exchangeable, and non-transferable. GA tickets cannot be upgraded to VIP.
- Official Sales Channel: Only tickets purchased through www.sentermusicfestival.com or official ticketing support (tickets@lfg-entertainment.com) are valid.

title: Senter Fest Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
Official Frequently Asked Questions for Senter Fest 2026:
1. Ticket & Entry:
- Ticket Validity: Your ticket is valid for both days of Senter Fest.
- Re-entry: Re-entry is not permitted. Each ticket allows one entry per day.
- Gate Opening Time: Gates open at 4:00 PM on both days.
2. Age Requirements:
- Age Limit: Ticket holders must be 16 years or older to enter independently.
- Under 16: Guests under 16 years of age must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian, who must purchase the ticket on their behalf and accompany them to the event. (Children below 7 years old will not be admitted).
3. Prohibited Items:
- Strictly prohibited inside the festival: drugs and illegal substances, cigarettes and smoking products, weapons or dangerous objects, outside liquids and beverages, outside food, and alcohol. All guests are subject to security checks at the entrance.
4. Parking:
- Dedicated event parking is not available. Parking within the Port City area, where applicable, is at the vehicle owner's own risk. Please follow all parking regulations.
5. Refunds, Upgrades & Transfers:
- Refunds: All ticket sales are final and non-refundable. If Senter Fest is officially cancelled by the organisers, the full ticket value will be refunded according to the organiser's refund process.
- Upgrades: GA tickets cannot be upgraded to VIP.
- Transfers: Tickets are non-transferable and may only be used by the original ticket holder.
- Official Tickets: Only tickets issued through the official Senter Fest ticketing channel (tickets@lfg-entertainment.com or sentermusicfestival.com) are considered valid.
6. Weather:
- What happens if it rains: We dance in the rain! Senter Fest is an outdoor experience. Unless the event is officially cancelled by the organisers, the festival will continue as scheduled in changing weather conditions.

title: Senter Festival Ticketing Terms & Conditions
content:
Official Senter Festival Ticketing Terms and Conditions summary:
- Organizer: LFG GLOBAL ENTERTAINMENT GROUP PTE. LTD., operator of www.sentermusicfestival.com (Support: hello@lfg-entertainment.com / tickets@lfg-entertainment.com).
- General Ticket Conditions: All tickets are sold online and issued electronically. A valid electronic ticket containing a valid QR code must be presented for entry. Each ticket is valid for one admission per day. Once scanned and validated, a ticket is considered used and cannot be reused, transferred, or revalidated. Damaged, altered, or unreadable QR codes may be rejected. Organizers are not responsible for lost, stolen, or shared QR codes.
- Non-Refundable & Non-Transferable: All ticket sales are final. Tickets are strictly non-refundable, non-exchangeable, and non-transferable, except in cases of complete event cancellation by the Organizers, where expressly stated by the Organizer, or as required by applicable law.
- Purchase Limits: Maximum of ten (10) tickets per transaction / per valid identification document. Orders exceeding limits or suspected of fraud/bots may be cancelled.
- Identification & Verification: Attendees may be required to present original government-issued photo ID (NIC or Passport), ticket confirmation email, and valid QR code.
- Age Restrictions: Children below 7 years old will not be admitted. Persons aged 7 to 17 (under 16 per FAQ) must hold a valid ticket and be accompanied by a parent, legal guardian, or responsible adult aged 21 years or above. Persons 18+ may enter independently.
- Entry & Re-entry: Re-entry is strictly prohibited once a ticket holder exits the venue. Admission is subject to security checks and venue capacity.
- Unauthorized Resale & Fraud: Resale of tickets is strictly prohibited. Only purchase through www.sentermusicfestival.com or authorized partners. Resold, duplicated, or fraudulent tickets will be cancelled without refund.
- Security & Prohibited Items: Security screening at entrance. Prohibited items include weapons, illegal substances, explosives/flammable materials, professional recording equipment without authorization, outside food/beverages, cigarettes/smoking products, alcohol, and any dangerous objects.
- Event Delay, Postponement & Cancellation: If postponed, tickets remain valid for the rescheduled date. If cancelled in full and not rescheduled, full ticket value refund procedures will be announced. External expenses (flights, hotels, transport) will not be reimbursed.
- Artist & Programme Changes: Artists, performers, schedules, and stage timings are subject to change without automatically entitling ticket holders to refunds.
- Photography & Drones: Unauthorized professional photography, audio/video recording, live streaming, commercial recording, and drones are prohibited. By entering, attendees consent to incidental appearance in event promotional and archival media.
- Assumption of Risk & Force Majeure: Attendees voluntarily accept ordinary risks of a large-scale music festival. Organizers are not liable for failure to perform due to force majeure events.

title: Senter Festival Website Privacy Policy & Data Protection
content:
Official Senter Festival Website Privacy Policy (Last Updated: 20 August 2026):
- Data Controller: LFG GLOBAL ENTERTAINMENT GROUP PTE. LTD. (operator of www.sentermusicfestival.com and organizer of Senter Festival).
- Personal Data Collected:
  1. Personal Identity Data: First Name, Last Name, and National Identity Card (NIC) or Passport ID number.
  2. Contact Information: Email address.
  3. Transactional Information: Order details, ticket confirmation codes, and payment status.
  4. Technical Information: IP address, device type, browser information, and website usage data collected via essential cookies.
- Purposes of Data Processing:
  1. Ticket Delivery & Fulfillment: Processing transactions, issuing electronic tickets, and generating secure QR codes.
  2. Identity & Access Verification: Matching entry documentation at Port City Colombo against submitted NIC/Passport numbers and full names to verify ticket ownership, prevent fraud, and eliminate illegal scalping.
  3. Event Operations & Security: Managing crowd control, security checks, customer support, and operational notices (schedule adjustments, venue alerts).
  4. Marketing Communications: Sending promotional materials or event updates only with explicit consent or where permitted by law.
- Legal Basis for Processing: Contractual Necessity (order fulfillment and entry), Legal Compliance & Security (attendee identity verification, event safety, anti-fraud), and Consent (direct marketing).
- Data Sharing & Third Parties: Personal data is never sold, rented, or traded. Shared only with authorized ticketing/payment providers, venue & security operations at Port City Colombo (solely for identity validation and safety enforcement at gates), and legal/regulatory bodies if required by law.
- Data Security & Retention: Industry-standard technical and organizational security protocols protect sensitive identification data (NIC/Passport IDs). Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill event operations, customer support, and statutory accounting/legal obligations.
- User Rights: Subject to data protection laws, users have the right to request access to personal data held, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of personal information (when no longer required for active contract fulfillment or legal compliance), and unsubscribe from promotional marketing communications anytime.
- Privacy Contact: hello@lfg-entertainment.com | Website: www.sentermusicfestival.com

title: The 7 Immersive Festival Zones
content:
Senter Fest is engineered as an expansive multi-dimensional festival ecosystem featuring 7 distinct zones:
- 01 // Main Stage Arena: The central concert ground with high-impact audio-visual arrays, laser rigs, and headline performances.
- 02 // VIP Sky Lounge: Elevated viewing deck over the crowds with dedicated culinary stations and private premium bars.
- 03 // Halloween Experience Zone: Immersive spooky walkthroughs, Halloween-themed installations, and roving character performers.
- 04 // Food & Beverage Village: Dozens of gourmet food trucks, local Sri Lankan street bites, specialty cocktail bars, and hydration points.
- 05 // Brand Activation Areas: Interactive sponsor pop-ups, gamified contests, and festival merchandise.
- 06 // Content Creation Areas: Neon-lit custom backdrops, photo moments, and 360-degree video booths.
- 07 // Influencer & Media Lounge: A selective networking space for creators, VIP press, and artists.

title: Open Calls: DJ Battle, Cosplay & Wall Art Competitions
content:
Senter Fest provides platforms for emerging creative talent:
1. DJ Competition: Battle for a slot on the Senter Fest main stage. Guidelines and registration announcements will be posted on social media channels.
2. Cosplay Showcase: Halloween edition costume craftsmanship showcase with live runway presentation and grand prizes. (Registration has reached capacity for early rounds; stay tuned for updates).
3. Wall Art Competition: Top visual artists submit artwork with hashtag #djsnakesrilanka along with a Behind-The-Scenes (BTS) process video for grand awards and full festival access.

title: About Senter Records & LFG Entertainment
content:
Senter Music Festival is co-produced by Senter Records and LFG Global Entertainment Group Pte. Ltd.:
- Senter Records (www.senterrecords.com): A Sri Lankan music and entertainment collective dedicated to empowering local producers, DJs, and performers. Senter Records is the label behind 'Pem Kekula', the first mainstream EDM track to top all major broadcast and streaming charts in Sri Lanka.
- LFG Global Entertainment Group Pte. Ltd. (lfg-entertainment.com / sentermusicfestival.com): A premier live entertainment and concert production company operating across the Asia-Pacific region, curating arena-scale experiences, lighting choreography, and international tours.

title: DJ Senter Academy & Skill Development
content:
DJ Senter Academy (https://djsenter.com/academy) is the educational arm affiliated with Senter, offering masterclasses and hands-on coaching in:
- Electronic Music Production & Sound Design
- Professional DJ Mixing Techniques & Beatmatching
- Stage Presence & Live Performance
- Music Industry Networking & Career Development.

title: Past Editions & Festival Legacy
content:
Senter Music Festival has celebrated 5 major editions over 5 active years with over 150,000+ total attendees and 100+ artists:
- 2024 (December 31, 2024): SENTER NYE Edition at the Colombo Lotus Tower Grounds with midnight countdown pyro and lights.
- 2023 (June 9, 2023): SENTER featuring Walshy Fire from Major Lazer at The Marquee, Port City Colombo (presented by Coca-Cola) with DJ Jaz, DJ Mass, Romaine Willis, Apzi, and Binu Sax.
- 2023 (February 3, 2023): The XO Music Festival '23 at Port City Colombo with DJ Katch, Subandrio, and the viral XO Team.
- 2022 (March 12, 2022): SENTER March Edition at Excel World Colombo featuring DJ Katch, Iraj, Apzi, ADK, and Sandaru Sathsara.

title: Venue Details, Location, Gates & Parking at Port City Colombo
content:
Venue Information & Logistics:
- Location: Port City Colombo, Colombo 00100, Western Province, Sri Lanka.
- Port City is a modern coastal waterfront destination located in the heart of Colombo, offering scenic oceanfront festival grounds.
- Event Schedule & Gates: Gates open at 4:00 PM on both October 30 and October 31, 2026. Music and stage performances run from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM daily.
- Parking Policy: Dedicated event parking is NOT available. Parking within the Port City area, where applicable, is at the vehicle owner's own risk. Please follow all parking regulations and restrictions.
- Access & Transit: Easily accessible via Colombo Fort railway station and Central Bus Stand (5-10 minutes by taxi/tuk-tuk). Designated ride-share (Uber / PickMe) drop-off and pick-up zones.
- Weather: Senter Fest is an outdoor experience. The event will continue during changing weather and rain unless officially cancelled or postponed by organisers for safety.

title: Festival Rules, Age Restrictions, Prohibited Items & Security
content:
Official Festival Rules & Safety Policies:
- Age Restrictions: Ticket holders must be 16 years or older to enter independently. Guests under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian, who must purchase the ticket on their behalf and accompany them to the event. Children below 7 years old will not be admitted. Government-issued photo ID (NIC or Passport) required at entry.
- Prohibited Items: Drugs and illegal substances, cigarettes and smoking products, weapons or dangerous objects, outside liquids and beverages, outside food, alcohol, explosives/flammable materials, and unauthorized professional recording equipment or drones.
- Re-entry Policy: Re-entry is strictly not permitted. Each ticket allows one entry per day. Once you exit the festival venue, you cannot re-enter.
- Dress Code: Festival chic / EDM festival rave wear / Halloween themed costumes are strongly encouraged. Comfortable footwear recommended for open grounds.
- Security: All attendees are subject to security checks and screening at entrance gates.
- Medical & Hydration: Free water stations and on-site first aid / paramedic response units available across the venue.
